title: Easing the Burden on Makassar Residents, Sembako and Masks Distributed
excerpt: Relawan Nusantara together with Dyana Yassin distributed sembako (staple food) packages, 200 masks, and biscuits to ojol (online motorcycle taxi) drivers and people going about their activities on Jalan Hertasning, Makassar.
seoTitle: Food Packages and Masks Shared in Makassar - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Relawan Nusantara and Dyana Yassin distributed staple food packages, 200 masks, and biscuits to ojol drivers and the public on Jalan Hertasning, Makassar.
html:
Life on the road keeps online motorcycle taxi drivers and road users constantly exposed to dust, pollution, and the crush of daily routines. Moved by concern for these people, influencer Dyana Yassin rallied a sharing action in the form of sembako (staple food) packages, masks, and biscuits on Jalan Hertasning, Makassar City, on Tuesday, 20 October 2026.

The care gathered by Dyana Yassin was channeled through Relawan Nusantara in an activity that began at 5:00 p.m. WITA (Central Indonesia Time). The action involved online motorcycle taxi (ojol) drivers and local volunteers to reach people going about their activities around the location.

Sembako and 200 Masks Distributed to Road Users

The activity began with the handover of sembako packages to four ojol drivers who also helped carry out the action. After that, the volunteers handed out 200 masks and biscuits to motorcyclists and people passing along Jalan Hertasning.

For people who spend much of their time on the road, attention to their health and daily needs means a great deal. The mask distribution is expected to help reduce exposure to dust and pollution, while the biscuits can serve as an extra snack in between activities.

Through this action, Dyana Yassin brought care in the form of aid that the community could receive directly. The sembako packages given are also expected to help meet some of the recipients' needs.

Strengthening Care Through the Act of Sharing

This sharing activity is an example of how care rallied by an individual can reach the community through collaboration and well-organized aid distribution. The involvement of ojol drivers and local volunteers further strengthened the spirit of gotong royong (mutual cooperation) in bringing benefit to others.

Dyana Yassin expressed appreciation to the volunteers and everyone who helped the activity run smoothly. May this action inspire more people to nurture care and share according to their means, so that more and more people feel the benefit of kindness done together. Come contribute and share your best care here!

Luaskan Manfaat
